qa_pairs.question: Which glow plug component requires the highest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The standard glow plug (1AZ) at 25 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What screw types are used for the 4-inch glow plug?
Which components share the same screw type specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The 4-inch glow plug (2AZ) and wire to glow plug (3AZ) both use M21/M41/M51

qa_pairs.question: How much lower is the torque specification for the wire to glow plug compared to the standard glow plug?
What section number covers glow plugs in the Engine Electrical Equipment?
Which glow plug components have the same torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: None of the glow plug components share the same torque specification - they are 25 Nm, 20 Nm, and 4 Nm respectively
